newsitem.title: USA: NEES settles with unions on restructuring.
newsitem.headline: NEES settles with unions on restructuring.

text.p: New England Electric System said it has reached agreement with two unions -- the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers and the Utility Workers Union of America -- regarding benefits and other assistance to union employees that are impacted by the restructuring of the electric utility industry and the company's decision to divest its generation business.
It is anticipated that industry restructuring and divestiture will lead to reductions in the company's workforce, the utility pointed out.
It said the agreement includes provisions covering early retirement, severance benefits and contract succession to the new owner for both unions, which have a combined membership of 1,600.
In December 1996, NEES said, it reached agreement with its other union, the Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, which has a membership of 1,400 employees.
